description: List time entries in a Workspace within a date range, optionally filtered by assignee, task, List, Folder or Space. Returns each entry's id, duration, user, task and billable flag. Use to build timesheets or audit logged time.

assignee.description: A single user id or an array of user ids to filter entries by.

end_date.description: End of the date range (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

folder_id.description: Only return entries for tasks in this Folder id.

include_location_names.description: If true, include the List/Folder/Space names for each entry.

include_task_tags.description: If true, include each task's tags in the result.

list_id.description: Only return entries for tasks in this List id.

space_id.description: Only return entries for tasks in this Space id.

start_date.description: Start of the date range (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms). Omit for the default window.

task_id.description: Only return entries logged against this task id.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_time_entries
